result.instructions: Tools for Current RMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Current RMS data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run current_rms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run current_rms_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run current_rms_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. current_rms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: current_rms_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members — Current RMS's single record type for Organisations, Contacts, Venues and Users. Free-text search covers name, street, work phone, work email and tags. Defaults to active records; filtermode can be active, inactive, all, organisation, contact, venue, user, with_pending_activities, with_live_opportunities, bookable. Current RMS: GET /members.

search.description: Free-text search on name, street, work phone, work email, user email or tags.

filtermode.description: Built-in filter, e.g. all, organisation, contact, venue, user, inactive.

filters.description: Extra Current RMS query-engine predicates, sent as q[<key>]=<value> (arrays become q[<key>][]). Examples: {"updated_at_gt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}, {"number_eq": "003664"}, {"status_not_eq": 40}, {"work_email_address_eq": "abc@test.com"}, {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1"}. Unknown predicates are silently ignored by the API.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. ["name asc"] or ["updated_at desc", "id asc"]. Add "id asc" when paging so the order is deterministic.

view_id.description: Record id of a saved custom view to apply.

tools.name: current_rms_get_member
tools.title: Get one member
tools.description: Fetch one member (organisation, contact, venue or user) with its addresses, emails, phones, links, linked parent/child members and custom fields. Current RMS: GET /members/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities — the enquiries, drafts, quotations and orders for a rental job — with their dates, state and charge totals. Free-text search covers subject, description, number, customer name and tags. filtermode e.g. live, all, inactive, enquiries, drafts, quotations, orders, invoiced, not_invoiced, needing_prep. Line items are NOT included here: use current_rms_get_opportunity or current_rms_list_opportunity_items. Max 25 per page. Current RMS: GET /opportunities.

search.description: Free-text search on subject, description, number, customer name or tags.

filtermode.description: Built-in filter, e.g. live, all, quotations, orders, not_invoiced.

filters.description: Extra Current RMS query-engine predicates, sent as q[<key>]=<value> (arrays become q[<key>][]). Unknown predicates are silently ignored by the API.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. ["name asc"] or ["updated_at desc", "id asc"]. Add "id asc" when paging so the order is deterministic.

include.description: Associations to embed in each record.

view_id.description: Record id of a saved custom view to apply.

tools.name: current_rms_get_opportunity
tools.title: Get one opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one opportunity with its dates, state (0 Enquiry, 1 Draft, 2 Quotation, 3 Order), status and charge/cost totals. Associations (customer, venue, line items, assets, participants) are only returned when named in include. Current RMS: GET /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_opportunity_items
tools.title: List an opportunity's line items
tools.description: List the line items on one opportunity — products, services and groups, with quantity, rate, discount, dates and charge totals. Current RMS: GET /opportunities/{opportunity_id}/opportunity_items.

include.description: Associations to embed on each line.

tools.name: current_rms_list_product_inventories
tools.title: List product inventory
tools.description: Stock snapshot per product: rental quantity held, booked, unavailable, on sub-rent and AVAILABLE, plus sale stock and prices. Pass starts_at/ends_at to compute rental availability for a job's dates instead of today, and store_id to restrict to one store. filtermode: active, inactive, all, rental, sale. Current RMS: GET /product_inventories.

tools.name: current_rms_check_product_availability
tools.title: Check a product's availability
tools.description: Rental availability for ONE product over a date range: arrays of quantity held, booked, unavailable, available, on sub-rent and quoted — one entry per availability period (hour, quarter day, half day or day depending on the range and system setting) — plus the opportunities that book it. Read-only, even though the API uses POST. Current RMS: POST /availability/product.

days_period.description: Number of days to report on.

Pass product_id for one product's stock, or use filters such as {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1234"} to find an asset. Current RMS: GET /stock_levels or GET /products/{product_id}/stock_levels.

tools.name: current_rms_create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: Create an Organisation, Contact or Venue. To link a new Contact to its Organisation, pass parent_member_id. Current RMS: POST /members.

type_id.description: Email type list-value id (4001 = Work in a default setup).
Phone type list-value id (6001 = Work in a default setup).

parent_member_id.description: Organisation (or Venue) member id to link this Contact to.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name.

tools.name: current_rms_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: Update fields on an existing member. Only the fields you pass are sent. Emails and phones passed here are ADDED (existing ones are kept). When updating custom_fields, also pass the member's membership_type. Current RMS: PUT /members/{id}.

membership_type.description: The member's EXISTING type — required by the API when updating custom_fields.

active.description: Set false to make the member inactive (reversible).

type_id.description: Email type list-value id (4001 = Work in a default setup).
Phone type list-value id (6001 = Work in a default setup).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name.

tools.name: current_rms_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create an opportunity (a rental job) as an Enquiry, Draft or Quotation. store_id is required (see current_rms_list_stores); set member_id for the customer and starts_at/ends_at for the job dates. Line items are added in Current RMS. Current RMS: POST /opportunities.

store_id.description: The store the job is served from.

state.description: 0 = Enquiry, 1 = Draft, 2 = Quotation. Converting to an Order is left to Current RMS.

billing_address_id.description: The member's address id used for billing.

project_id.description: The project this opportunity belongs to.

reference.description: Customer reference, e.g. their PO number.

owned_by.description: User member id of the owner.

customer_collecting.description: The customer collects the goods themselves.

customer_returning.description: The customer returns the goods themselves.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name.

tools.name: current_rms_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Update header fields on an existing opportunity — subject, customer, venue, dates, reference, instructions, tags, custom fields. Only the fields you pass are sent. State changes (convert to quote/order, cancel, mark lost) are deliberately not available. Current RMS: PUT /opportunities/{id}.

store_id.description: Move the job to another store.

billing_address_id.description: The member's address id used for billing.

project_id.description: The project this opportunity belongs to.

reference.description: Customer reference, e.g. their PO number.

owned_by.description: User member id of the owner.

customer_collecting.description: The customer collects the goods themselves.

customer_returning.description: The customer returns the goods themselves.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name.

tools.name: current_rms_create_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Log an activity (call, meeting, task, note) against a member, opportunity or project, optionally with participants. Current RMS: POST /activities.

regarding_type.description: The kind of record it concerns, e.g. "Opportunity", "Member" or "Project".

owned_by.description: User member id of the owner.

participant_member_ids.description: Member ids to add as participants.
